source.title: ダブルダガー(Double Dagger)
source.author: しゑひ(shiwehi)
source.fetch_method: curl through the session proxy, TLS verification ON, with --cacert naming a bundle that adds the Let's Encrypt YE2 intermediate (shiwehi.com omits it from its chain), the method STSD, STMB Cave, インペリアルクロス, 山岳積み2号 and stick spin used. The snapshot is the page's raw HTML, byte for byte; every board is plain text in it, 14 ten-wide boards in page order.
source.snapshot_note: sha256 of the raw HTML this transcription was checked against. Not re-verifiable in CI: the page is not committed and cannot be fetched there. Re-check with --html-dir after any refetch; an HTML hash moves with ANY byte of the page (ads, sidebar, a date), so a moved hash means "read the board diff", not "the boards changed". Sentences are compared against the page with its tags dropped.

quotes.verbatim: ここでは、ダブルダガー(Double Dagger)という、TSDを2回打つことができる中盤テンプレについて紹介していきます。
基本形とラインの消し方
基本形は上図の通りです。
ここから、TSDを打つと、もう一度TSDを打てる形が残ります。
元地形からの組み方と特徴
1つ目の組み方としては、既に完成されたTSDの形からやを置き、反対側にやで屋根を付ける方法です。
quotes.icons_note: the page draws the four pieces as mino icons (<span class="mino jmino"> and so on) in the four gaps 「から_や_を置き、反対側に_や_で」; the text drops them. Not used as a caption.

quotes.verbatim: 薄い灰色の部分は適当に埋めてください。
TSDを打つ準備をしていたのに%Tが遅い場合などに組んでおくことでBack-to-backを狙えます。
屋根の反対側(ピンクマス)が埋まっていないときにのみ使えます。
2つ目に、既に完成された十字形からやを乗せて作る方法です。
quotes.icons_note: the page draws the two pieces as mino icons in the gaps 「から_や_を乗せて」; the text drops them. Not used as a caption.

quotes.verbatim: ダブルダガーを組む代わりにインペリアルクロスを組むこともできます。
インペリアルクロスと異なり穴が左右にズレないので、下穴が直列で空いている場合にテトリスを打つことができる。
2つのT-spinの間に邪魔にならなければラインが入っていても良い。
3つ以上重ねることもできる(マルチダガー(Multi Dagger))

nodes.label: the basic form: two TSD slots stacked, the upper one roofed over its left end; the dark-grey cells are left open
the T laid flat, pointing down, into the upper slot: a TSD
what the TSD leaves: the overhang dropped onto the lower slot, a second TSD slot
the TSD shape: a finished TSD slot with a step beside it; dark grey where the shape is built
a J stood into the corner and an S roof on the other side (the stack beside them drawn muted)
the TSD shape again, the cell opposite the roof marked pink: it must be empty
the cross shape, finished, no roof
a Z laid over the cross's right arm: the overhang on the RIGHT, the page's mirrored hand
the Z one column left: インペリアルクロス, a different technique
a Double Dagger (mirrored) over a well in the same column: an I through the well, a tetris
what the tetris leaves: the Double Dagger, untouched
a line between the two slots (mirrored): the T into the upper slot, a TSD
what that TSD leaves: the overhang over the line, the lower slot under it
three slots stacked (マルチダガー, mirrored), the third under a line

variants.window_note: in basic.spin's frame, row 0 the top: the bounding box of the T, the overhang above it and the follow-up slot. Rows 2-3 are the rows the TSD clears (entailed by the clear at a full TSD, NaiveClauseForced); row 1 is the overhang (the roof over the T's left end and the cell beside it filled, the two cells over the rest of the T empty); rows 4-5 are the lower slot, directly under the upper one, with the wall behind it. The lower slot's far wall (column 6) and the headroom row are outside. Occupancy only, never colour; garbage is filled.

followup.note: the flat T into the lower slot, under the dropped overhang. It lies below the two cleared rows, so the TSD does not move it; the matcher carries it through every later clear to the next T.

not_expressed.reason: the page's second feature: a line between the two slots. The window wants the lower slot directly under the upper one, so it does not fire; with the line row (row 6) taken out it fires, mirrored, at the drawn T. A different spacing of the same idea, reported and not matched

cross_source.note: the window, by the gate's predicate (technique_transcription.window_fires), over every U-slot board of every committed *-routes.json, with the U cells as the T. `fires` is the independent drawer (harddrop's SDPC Spin page, another author): the T in the slot its second C-Spin build makes, directly on top of the C-Spin's residue slot, the build's Z or S the overhang. No routes board is labelled as this technique. The same author's インペリアルクロス page is checked in `technique_pages`.
